input.title: [Command Center] Tapping the Delete button dismisses the Command Center
input.body:
When tapping the Delete button (fire icon) inside the Command Center, the Command Center is immediately dismissed. It’s unclear whether this behavior is intended or accidental. Given the close proximity of the Delete button to the Done button (which dismisses the Command Center), this may result in accidental interactions, or the delete action itself may be unintentionally triggering the dismissal.

https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/7307456/524194126-e506dd44-2f17-4839-a7ee-e3d60eb39e5e.mov?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..wbfQ6WOhzvn8ePMkKvSo09oe3gN5YJysrvk5Jdd4QpE

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Select a thought.
2. Open the Command Center by swiping up.
3. Tap the Delete button (fire icon).

## Current Behavior
The Command Center closes immediately after tapping the Delete button.

## Expected Behavior
Tapping the Delete button performs the delete action without dismissing the Command Center, unless dismissal is explicitly intended by design.
